# katazuku-shukatsu

> Local-first, human-in-the-loop automation core for Japanese shukatsu (new-grad job hunting).
> An agent is the single writer over one local SQLite source of truth, with a state-transition
> engine, entity resolution, idempotency, audit events, and safety boundaries enforced in code.
> Runtime dependency-free (uses Node's built-in node:sqlite); code in TypeScript.

## Getting started
- [README](README.md): overview, requirements (Node 22.5+, recommended 24), quickstart, multi-device/backup
- Run: `npm install`, then `npm run doctor`, `npm test`, `npm run seed`
- Real data defaults to the OS user-data directory outside the Git checkout; override the database path with `KATAZUKU_DB`.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): guide for AI agents and "how do I use this" answers

## Architecture and design
- [ARCHITECTURE](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): single-writer, SQLite source of truth, semantic layer, idempotency, audit events
- [SECURITY](SECURITY.md): safety boundaries (approval gates for submission, never proxy-take assessments)

## Key source files
- src/db.ts: schema + semantic layer (transition rules, company name resolution, idempotent appointment matching)
- src/db-apply*.ts: idempotent write layer (mail / interview / calendar inputs)
- src/application.ts: application-flow state machine
- src/agent-runtime.ts: provider-independent agent runtime (Claude / Codex / local)
- src/index.ts: public API entry point
